description: Two five-input summing mixers on one panel, each adding its inputs to one output

inputs.text: One of the five inputs added together in that mixer

outputs.text: The sum of that mixer's five inputs, added at full level

notes: nothing scales or limits the sum, so five inputs at 10V give 50V at the output
